# PeptShop

> PeptShop is a research compound marketplace that lets buyers compare per-mg pricing across vetted suppliers, view public Certificates of Analysis (CoAs), and checkout with cryptocurrency — no account required.

## What PeptShop does

PeptShop aggregates vendor offerings for research compounds (peptides, nootropics, cosmetics) into a single catalog. Buyers can:
- Compare **per-mg pricing** across multiple vendors for the same compound
- View **public CoAs** (Certificates of Analysis) from independent testing labs
- **Checkout with crypto** (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, XMR) — no signup, no email required
- Track orders and open disputes with **buyer escrow protection**

Vendors are identity-checked before listing. Vendors set wholesale prices; PeptShop applies a transparent markup. There are no fees or commissions — the vendor gets their wholesale price, PeptShop keeps the spread.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://peptshop.io/) — Browse popular compounds and featured vendors
- [Full catalog](https://peptshop.io/products) — All research compounds with vendor comparisons
- [Vendors](https://peptshop.io/vendors) — All verified vendors with ratings, order counts, and CoA counts
- [CoA Labs](https://peptshop.io/coas) — Independent lab test results for compounds
- [How it works](https://peptshop.io/#how-it-works) — 3-step buying process
- [Contact](https://peptshop.io/contact) — Support, vendor inquiries, press

## Value propositions

1. **Transparent per-mg pricing** — Every offering shows price per milligram, so buyers can compare value across vendors and dosages at a glance
2. **Public CoAs** — Lab test results (purity, identity, mass spec) are public on each vendor's profile, not hidden behind a login
3. **Crypto checkout** — Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, USDC, and Monero accepted. No account required to browse or buy
4. **Buyer escrow** — Payment is held in escrow until the buyer confirms delivery, protecting against non-shipment
5. **Vetted vendors** — Vendor identity is verified before onboarding. Vendors with poor test results or high dispute rates are suspended

## Compound categories

PeptShop lists research compounds in categories including:
- GLP-1 agonists (tirzepatide, retatrutide, semaglutide)
- Growth hormone secretagogues (tesamorelin, CJC-1295, ipamorelin)
- Cosmetics (GHK-Cu, copper peptides)
- NAD+ precursors and related compounds
- Other research peptides

## For vendors

Vendors can list on PeptShop by contacting vendors@peptshop.io. Vendors provide wholesale pricing; PeptShop handles the storefront, pricing display, payments, customer support, and buyer escrow. Vendors ship products and get paid their wholesale price in crypto — no fees, no commissions.

## Technical

- Built with Next.js 14 (App Router), deployed on Vercel
- Server-side rendered for crawlability
- Structured data (schema.org Product, Organization, AggregateOffer) on all product and vendor pages
- Sitemap available at /sitemap.xml
- Robots.txt at /robots.txt (AI crawlers explicitly allowed)
- Full LLM context at /llms-full.txt — detailed compound info, FAQ answers, vendor standards
- FAQ pages at /faq — common questions about peptide purchasing, CoAs, crypto escrow
